fib: ______ is the mechanism by which new cells are formed and by which these cells retain identical chromosome numbers and hereditary factors before and after every cell division.
Mitosis
Mitosis is the mechanism by which new cells are formed and by which these cells retain identical chromosome numbers and hereditary factors before and after every cell division.
______ is the ideal procedure to improve an otherwise excellent variety (Adapted Variety) which may be deficient in one or two traits.
Backcross method of breeding
Backcross method of breeding is the ideal procedure to improve an otherwise excellent variety (Adapted Variety) which may be deficient in one or two traits.
______ is the new variety that will look identical to the recurrent parent but with additional gene for resistance.
Genotype RR
Genotype RR is the new variety that will look identical to the recurrent parent but with additional gene for resistance.
______ is the parent donating resistant genes (non-recurrent) to the recurrent parent that is adapted and high yielding.
Donor parent
Donor parent is the parent donating resistant genes (non-recurrent) to the recurrent parent that is adapted and high yielding.
______ is the new variety or improved population.
Composed seed
Composed seed is the new variety or improved population.
______ is the process of transfer of pollen grains from the anther of a flower to the stigma of the same flower.
Self pollination
Self pollination is the process of transfer of pollen grains from the anther of a flower to the stigma of the same flower.
______ is a process in which gametes are formed which includes meiosis by which the chromosome number is changed from the diploid or 2n number to the haploid or n number.
Gametogenesis
Gametogenesis is a process in which gametes are formed which includes meiosis by which the chromosome number is changed from the diploid or 2n number to the haploid or n number.

tags

______ is the ability to recognize superior plants in a limited or vast array of variability.
Selection
Selection is the ability to recognize superior plants in a limited or vast array of variability.
______ is an advanced open-pollinated seed mixture of a group of strains or inbred.
Synthetic variety
Synthetic variety is an advanced open-pollinated seed mixture of a group of strains or inbred.
